build_IPSEstimator: build an IPS estimator to evaluate a target policy using importance sampling weights on logged bandit data
build_DoublyRobustEstimator: build a doubly robust estimator combining direct method predictions with importance sampling for off-policy evaluation
build_PBMEstimator: build a position-based click model estimator to evaluate ranking policies using slot examination probabilities
build_DMEstimator: build a direct method estimator that trains a model on slate features to predict rewards for off-policy evaluation
build_PseudoInverseEstimator: build a pseudo-inverse estimator that uses slot-item expectations to compute importance weights for slate evaluation
